text_block_list.text:
The day of her debut race arrived. Ines 
Fujin's twin little sisters came to cheer 
her on. Doting over them, she was the very 
picture of a good big sister.

Energized by the cute dancing cheers she 
received, Ines Fujin is fully motivated 
for the sake of the two of them!

What kind of race awaits her? With her 
heart pounding with excitement, Ines 
Fujin's debut race is about to begin...!
